identity.name: Blacksmith's Apron
identity.summary: A broad soot stained leather apron with a bronze waist plate.
identity.description: Reduces each enemy strike by 2 before block. Applies 1 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: The forge is cold but the apron still smells of iron.
